address: Lindauer Straße 75, Isny im Allgäu, 88316, Germany
bio: Good food and a pleasant family-style atmosphere are the main draws of this restaurant run by the cordial Rimmele family, whose dedication to their work is palpable – that is certainly the case for chef Susanne Rimmele. She cooks regional as well as Mediterranean dishes. The menu includes options such as beef goulash with seasonal vegetables and bread dumplings, and house-made ricotta and spinach ravioli with braised tomatoes. The front-of-house team are charming and provide service with a smile. Tip: the delightful terrace. They also offer cookery classes, tackling pasta, asparagus or game. Pleasant overnight accommodation is available at Hotel Hohe Linde....
